parameters.m: P residual thresholds: initial L1/L5 50/30 m, final 20/15 m.
D residual thresholds: initial 20 m/s, final 3 m/s.
SNR noise model, signal weights, robust kernels, IMU noise and bias noise do not branch on initflag in this file; they may depend on phone/course settings.
fgo_gnss_imu.m: Initial uses GNSS output plus velocity-derived attitude; final uses prior IMU output, optionally resetting attitude when RPYReset=1.
Zero-velocity and relative/reference-height factors are final-only.
Stationary pose factors remain in both passes with strict raw UTC difference < 1.5 s.

scope: Source inspection plus existing settings inventory. Current comparison routes all request RPYReset=0, so carrying their estimated attitude matches that choice. Cases requesting reset need separate support and verification before any all-phone source-parity claim. This does not verify the broader native noise, prior, observation or solver models.
